_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. namespace = the fixed namespace the <Namespace> placeholder is substituted for; placeholders = the skill's other placeholders, resolved to values that exist in the reference instance; assets = the chosen-approach files to include (Approach A: single-file sitemap — excludes SitemapIndexController.cs to avoid a duplicate /sitemap.xml route).
